name: stats-nz-datafinder
description: Queries Stats NZ Datafinder WFS layers and exposes layer metadata for geographic analysis.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.help_text: Create a key at https://datafinder.stats.govt.nz/my/api/. The key must be authorised to query layer data through WFS and to read public layer details.

query_layer_by_geometry.description: Returns compact attribute records from a Datafinder layer. Scope with a Polygon/MultiPolygon (area-weighted overlap), a Point (containing feature, no area-weighting), a bbox, and/or attribute filters. Census VAR_* columns are omitted unless listed in fields or include_coded_fields is true. Use ieq (not contains) for an exact area name. Geometry is omitted unless include_geometry is true. Unscoped national scans are rejected.

geometry.description: RFC 7946 WGS84 Point, Polygon, or MultiPolygon. Point = 'what is here'; Polygon = catchment clip with overlap_fraction.

bbox.description: WGS84 bounding box [west, south, east, north]. Alternative to geometry; do not send both. Longitudes outside [-180, 180] (e.g. Datafinder east=184.5) are wrapped; a box that crosses 180° is split.

attribute_filters.description: Optional filters combined with AND. Use ieq for an exact area name (case-insensitive). contains is a substring match — 'Wellington Central' also matches 'Mount Wellington Central'. Sufficient on their own when looking up a named area.

fields.description: Attribute names to return. Use after get_layer_metadata. If omitted, VAR_* census codes are dropped and coded_fields_omitted reports how many. An empty list is rejected.

include_coded_fields.description: If true and fields is omitted, return VAR_* census columns. Default false — those columns are the main cause of agent context compaction.

include_geometry.description: If true, include each feature's GeoJSON geometry. Default false.

max_pages.description: Maximum WFS pages to retrieve. truncated is true when more matching features exist.

records.description: Matching features as attribute records. Geometry is omitted unless include_geometry is true.

overlap_fraction.description: Share of the feature's polygon inside the query shape. This is an area share, not a population share. 1.0 for point and attribute-only queries. Null for line/point features (no area to share).

truncated.description: True when matching features beyond page_size × max_pages were omitted.

total_matched.description: WFS numberMatched when the server reports it.

coded_fields_omitted.description: Count of VAR_* census columns not returned. Pass those names in fields to retrieve them.

get_layer_metadata.description: Returns citation-ready Stats NZ Datafinder layer metadata, a short description, the layer field list, coded_field_count for Census VAR_* columns, the catalogue page URL, and attachment links (lookups/codebooks when present).

description.description: First paragraph of the catalogue description, truncated for agent context.

fields.description: Non-geometry fields from the layer schema. Titles are included when the API provides them. coded is true for Census VAR_* columns.

coded_field_count.description: Number of VAR_* census columns. Query with fields to retrieve specific ones.

page_url.description: Catalogue page for the layer (not the API JSON URL).

attachments.description: Lookup/codebook files when Datafinder publishes them.

search_layers.description: Searches public vector layers. Returns compact cards (id, title, published_at, queryable) so an agent can pick a layer_id without fetching full metadata.

keyword.description: Catalogue search keyword, e.g. 'census' or 'statistical area'.
